sentence: ICT capability and a firm's technological readiness must be in place before AI-based management of partner relationships improves performance
passage: [Samadhiya et al. (2023), p. 510] "The findings of the study show that information communication technology capability and technological readiness play a significant role in improving the performance of AI-based partner relationship management."

gemini.note: The passage states that these capabilities play a significant role in improving performance, but the sentence exaggerates this by claiming they are strict prerequisites.
